description: Source code implementing Physical Memory Protection (PMP) management for RISC-V architecture in Zephyr OS, including PMP initialization, configuration, and context switch handling.

methods.name: print_pmp_entries
methods.description: Prints the current PMP entries for debugging purposes.

methods.name: dump_pmp_regs
methods.description: Reads and logs all PMP register states.

methods.name: set_pmp_entry
methods.description: Configures a PMP slot with specified address, permissions, and size.

methods.name: write_pmp_entries
methods.description: Writes a range of PMP entries to hardware registers.

methods.name: z_riscv_pmp_thread_init
methods.description: Initializes thread-specific PMP register copies with global values.

methods.name: z_riscv_pmp_stackguard_prepare
methods.description: Prepares PMP entries for thread stack guard.

methods.name: z_riscv_pmp_stackguard_enable
methods.description: Enables PMP stack guard entries during context switch.

methods.name: z_riscv_pmp_usermode_init
methods.description: Initializes user mode PMP configuration for a thread.

methods.name: z_riscv_pmp_usermode_prepare
methods.description: Prepares PMP entries for user mode thread.

methods.name: resync_pmp_domain
methods.description: Updates PMP entries based on memory domain partitions.

methods.name: z_riscv_pmp_usermode_enable
methods.description: Activates user mode PMP entries during context switch.

methods.name: arch_mem_domain_max_partitions_get
methods.description: Calculates maximum number of memory domain partitions that can be mapped.

methods.name: arch_mem_domain_partition_add
methods.description: Adds a partition to a memory domain.

methods.name: arch_mem_domain_partition_remove
methods.description: Removes a partition from a memory domain.

methods.name: arch_mem_domain_thread_add
methods.description: Prepares a thread for memory domain changes.

methods.name: arch_mem_domain_thread_remove
methods.description: Handles thread removal from a memory domain.

methods.name: arch_buffer_validate
methods.description: Validates if a buffer address range is accessible under current PMP settings.
